steps.name: Schedule the Wild Encounter
steps.do: Open **Set Wild Encounter schedule**. Choose **Masai Giraffe**, set the date range to include **today**, add a recurring row with **today’s weekday** and encounter time **1:00 PM**, then submit.
steps.expect: Success that the schedule was saved.

steps.name: Schedule the overlapping talk
steps.do: Open **Add Meet the Guardians talk occurrence**. Choose **Location** **Africa Savanna** and **Talk name** **African Penguin**, set **Date** to today, enter **Talk time** **1:30 PM**, then submit.
steps.expect: Success that the occurrence was added.

steps.name: Build for today
steps.do: From the bottom nav, open **Itinerary**. Use **Build Itinerary** / **Edit Itinerary**, set the visit date to **today**, add **Masai Giraffe** and **African Penguin** on **Add Animals**, then on Meet the Guardians and **Wild Encounters** add the **African Penguin** **1:30 PM** talk and the **Masai Giraffe** **1:00 PM** encounter.
steps.expect: Both animals and both timed activities are selected on the builder.

steps.name: Finish into conflicts
steps.expect: **Your Itinerary Has the Following Issues:** appears, including **Schedule Conflicts** listing both activities.

steps.name: Select the encounter
steps.do: In **Schedule Conflicts**, select the **Masai Giraffe** Wild Encounter with **+**.
steps.expect: The Wild Encounter is marked selected.

steps.name: Select the overlapping talk
steps.do: Select the **African Penguin** Meet the Guardians talk with **+** as well.
steps.expect: **Adjust Activity Times?** appears with message **These selections overlap in time. We’ll fit them into your day by shortening some activities, with Wild Encounters taking priority.** and **Proceed** / **Cancel**.

steps.name: Cancel trim
steps.expect: The Meet the Guardians talk is not selected; you remain on **Your Itinerary Has the Following Issues:** / **Schedule Conflicts**.

steps.name: Proceed with trim
steps.do: Select the **African Penguin** talk again, click **Proceed** on **Adjust Activity Times?**, then click **Proceed** on **Your Itinerary Has the Following Issues:**.
steps.expect: The issues dialog closes and the itinerary saves with both activities kept.

steps.name: Day Planner shows shortened talk
steps.do: Open **Day Planner View** and find both activities.
steps.expect: Both pills are on the timeline. **Masai Giraffe** keeps **1:00 PM–1:45 PM**. **African Penguin** is shortened to **1:45 PM–2:00 PM** (still ending at the original **2:00 PM**, not stretched past it).

steps.name: Trim persists
steps.do: Reload the page, open **Itinerary**, and return to **Day Planner View**.
steps.expect: Both activities remain scheduled with the same trimmed talk timing.
